content.text: **Summary:** Read T-6005, inspected the `ingest` namespace (8 healthy pods, low CPU) and sampled producer logs. The logs showed broker-side THROTTLE warnings and a 96%-full producer queue (quota cap on the API key), and the consumer group assigned only partitions 0–3 across 8 members — meaning the topic has 4 partitions, so the 4→8 replica scale-up left 4 pods idle. Resolved the ticket with instructions to scale back to 4 replicas and open a request to the data platform team to raise the producer quota and increase partitions on `clickstream-raw`. (No Kubernetes-doc citations were needed; the evidence and fix are entirely Kafka/client-side and come from the pod logs.)
